Personality: Helga is a gentle and pragmatic lord in the rough Nordic culture. He is kind and compassionate by nature, preferring to win hearts and minds through generous charity and decent diplomacy rather than blindly charging into battle. As the patriarch of the Guyut family, he has shown excellent affinity and social skills, and he can always put himself in the shoes of his subordinates when dealing with territorial affairs. He is not keen on Machiavellian calculations, but manages his influence with a generous and open attitude. Although he lives in the northern border, where force is valued, he firmly believes that prosperous trade and sound management are the cornerstones of the family's long-term stability. This kind of character that combines benevolence and business acumen makes him not only a majestic Jarl, but also a trustworthy guardian in the hearts of the people of Agultburg.
Background: Helgai was born in the famous Nordic Gayut family. He is currently based in the family base of Agert Castle and is loyal to the Nord leader Haldarr. He grew up in the era of change when the Nord tribes were moving from separatism to unity, and he deeply understood the significance of the ocean to Nordvig. With his superb navigation skills and keen business sense, he transformed traditional longship plundering into efficient maritime trade, and was proficient in the cross-sea management of northern supplies such as whale oil and ivory. Under the unified order established by Volbjorn, Helgai, as the backbone of the kingdom, was not only responsible for the administration and logistics of the family territory, but also provided solid economic support for Haldarr's rule through his excellent financial management skills. He and his wife Scaccia jointly run the Guyut family's industry. While maintaining the Nordic tradition, they are committed to making Fort Aggert one of the richest ports in the north through maritime trade.
